findings.evidence: `RelNorm.lean:54-55`: `variable {R S : Type*} ... [IsDedekindDomain R] [IsDedekindDomain S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]`; `ExtendedRelNorm.lean:82-83` instantiates this with `S := M`, giving `[IsDedekindDomain M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M]`, neither of which the docstring mentions.
findings.fix: State it: `M` is a Dedekind domain that is module-finite and torsion-free over the Dedekind domain `R`; `A` is a domain mapping into `M` torsion-freely.
findings.issue: The docstring allocates hypotheses per direction — "the extension needs only that `A → M` is an injective map of domains, while the norm needs `M` module-finite over `R`" — but the norm side also needs `IsDedekindDomain M` and `Module.IsTorsionFree R M` (variables, lines 82–83). The setup sentence (line 15) calls `M` merely a "common overring" and names only `R` as Dedekind, so the file's strongest assumption is invisible in the documentation.

findings.evidence: Compare `ExtendedRelNorm.lean:46-72` with the PR description's `## Provenance` section — same two bullets, same claims, reworded. Contrast `RelNorm.lean:34-47`, whose Provenance credits actually ported declarations and lists concrete deviations.
findings.fix: Cut to a two-line provenance note (nothing ported; related AINTLIB work at rev `513e83879e2f` treats the endomorphism case) plus the one-sentence design reason for the three-type signature, and leave the absence survey and the comparison essay in the PR description.
findings.issue: Lines 46–72 are PR-review argumentation transplanted into permanent documentation: a novelty claim about Mathlib ("no `relNorm`-of-an-extension appears there in any spelling") that goes stale the moment upstream adds one, and 18 lines describing the contents and file headers of an unported external repository, which no reader of this file can check and which no declaration here depends on. It duplicates the PR description's `## Implementation notes` and `## Provenance` sections nearly verbatim.

summary: The module docstring's explicit per-direction hypothesis accounting omits the file's strongest assumptions (`IsDedekindDomain M`, `Module.IsTorsionFree R M`), so a reader concludes `M` is an arbitrary overring. Separately, ~30 lines of the docstring are PR-review argumentation about upstream absence and another repo's internals, copied from the PR description.
